latest.title: Z-Deck 0.2.64-cyberdeck
latest.notes: Replaces launcher paging with six large direct controls matching the sketch: Alerts, Map, Messages, Contacts, Tools, and Settings. The compact header and footer keep clock, battery, mesh, GPS, SD, and unread state visible. The dual USB migration installer preserves NVS, LittleFS, SD files, channels, keys, and local preferences.
